name: pointer-hold-then-drag-dispatches-gesture
description: a `down, wait, move, up` sequence (a stationary hold followed by a drag) dispatches through the waypoint-based gesture path with an explicit same-coordinate hold segment, not through the coordinate-only Swipe primitive
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: pointer hold then drag
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- pointer:
    touches:
      - actions:
          - down:
              x: 10
              y: 10
          - wait: 800
          - move:
              x: 100
              y: 200
          - up
